verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments platform, since some payment orchestration products ship self-hostable deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows EBANX offering a self-hosted or on-premise deployment of its core product. The docs describe EBANX-run APIs, tenant endpoints and checkout pages managed by EBANX; keeping a JWS private key in your own infrastructure is an adjacent security detail, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
